text.greet_1: What's good, everybody! Welcome to battle night! It's DJ Crossfade on the decks, and you already know how we do it in here!
text.greet_2: Make some noise! It's battle night, and tonight somebody's going home humbled!
text.greet_3: Yo, yo, yo! Can I get some energy in here? Welcome out to battle night!
text.mc_big_poopy_pants: Uh... somebody wandered in from the birthday party next door. Give it up for... Poop McPants!
text.mc_lil_nervous: In this corner: first battle ever, so be nice... or don't! Lil Nervous!
text.mc_mc_static: In this corner: five years running the Thursday cypher, a legend in their own mind... MC Static!
text.mc_loose_cannon: Security, stay close. Banned from two leagues and back for more... Loose Cannon!
text.mc_kid_venom: In this corner: undefeated this season, and the homework's already done on you... Kid Venom!
text.mc_the_champ: Everybody on your feet. Twelve-time champion, battle rap royalty... The Champ!
text.mc_any: In this corner: tonight's house MC! Give it up!
text.ch_1: And their challenger tonight, put your hands together for...
text.ch_2: And stepping up to the mic, the challenger! Make some noise for...
text.ch_3: And in the other corner, straight out of the dressing room, it's...
text.anon_1: And in the other corner, a brand new face! Show the challenger some love!
text.anon_2: And their challenger, stepping up for the very first time! Make some noise!
text.go_1: Alright, alright! Let's get it on!
text.win_lead_1: Alright, alright, settle down! The crowd has spoken... and your winner is...
text.win_lead_2: Okay, okay! What a battle! Your winner tonight...
text.win_lead_3: Make some noise one more time! And the winner is...
text.win_mc_big_poopy_pants: Poop McPants?! Somebody call the birthday party!
text.win_mc_lil_nervous: Lil Nervous! First battle ever, and the nerves held up!
text.win_mc_mc_static: MC Static! The Thursday cypher legend lives on!
text.win_mc_loose_cannon: Loose Cannon! Somebody check on the challenger!
text.win_mc_any: The house MC! Holding it down!
text.win_you_2: The new face! Straight out of the dressing room and straight to the top!
text.draw_1: Hold up... it's a tie! Too close to call! Give it up for both of them!
text.draw_2: I can't split them! It's a draw! Make some noise for both of these MCs!
